conventions.inputs: float32-rounded elevation, cell sizes, zFactor; float64 reference arithmetic
conventions.units: metres for elevation and spacing; all compared curvatures in 1/metre
conventions.sign: convex positive for profile/plan/tangential; ordinary Hessian trace for laplacian
conventions.nodata: null decodes to NaN; any invalid fitting-window cell invalidates output
conventions.boundary: clamp repeats edge cells; nodata invalidates incomplete windows
conventions.seamCheck: all real core outputs checked against a united window during generation
